description: Rent-a-Bot: rename. WHEN: you already have an active rental and want to change the public nickname on the RENTED tag. Only the renter, only while the rental is active, and only between matches (mid-match rename is a VIP perk from Nov 26; House Bot can rename between matches). Same nickname rules as rent_hire (reserved names, no impersonating a real handle, no city-pa/system). Rate-limited to 3 renames per rental. Does not change time left, escrow, or billing. Past match records, receipts, and ledger rows keep the name they were played under. Registered key required. Example: rent_rename {"hire_id":"<hire_id>","nickname":"<nickname>"}

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only; guest keys cannot rent.
